page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c28g1.7xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine type within the Compute Optimized with GPU family. Built on the KVM hypervisor and an x86_64 architecture, it is powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor operating at 2.5 GHz. The instance configuration allocates 28 dedicated vCPUs corresponding to 14 physical cores with multithreading enabled, supported by a 40 MB L3 cache. Memory capacity totals 112 GB, maintaining an even 4 GB per vCPU allocation. For parallel acceleration, the host is equipped with a single NVIDIA Pascal P100 GPU featuring 16 GB of dedicated VRAM. Storage includes an integrated 472 GB local SSD, and networking provides a baseline bandwidth of 5 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations reveal distinct performance boundaries between the host CPU architecture and the attached accelerator. The Intel Xeon platform demonstrates average multi-core results across stress-ng and PassMark CPU suites, but exhibits weak single-threaded metrics, placing in the lower percentiles for single-core execution, gzip compression, and bzip3 decompression. In contrast, the NVIDIA P100 accelerator achieves top-tier results in language model prompt processing for both 135M and 7B parameter models, alongside competitive text generation speeds. In-memory throughput and database operations align with mid-range baselines, recording 19.05 million operations per second in Redis SET tests.

The qualitative profile of this server reflects older hardware architecture balanced by a dense allocation of resources. Because the configuration combines dedicated compute, substantial system memory, high-speed local scratch disk, and a 16 GB enterprise GPU in a single package, it functions efficiently for specialized pipelines without requiring separated storage or acceleration tiers. Tradeoffs stem primarily from legacy CPU instruction support and lower per-core compute output compared to newer generations. The instance is best suited for medium-scale machine learning inference, distributed batch processing, parallel computer vision pipelines, and GPU-assisted scientific computing.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c28g1.7xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance designed for compute-intensive and parallel processing workloads. Driven by an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz, the configuration delivers 28 dedicated vCPUs across 14 physical cores, supported by 112 GB of system memory, 472 GB of local SSD storage, and a baseline network throughput of 5 Gbps. Acceleration is supplied by a dedicated NVIDIA Pascal P100 GPU with 16 GB of VRAM. Benchmark results reflect standard middle-tier CPU and memory performance alongside weaker single-core processing metrics, balanced by top-tier inference throughput on small and medium language models. While its previous-generation architecture limits raw single-threaded compute efficiency relative to modern alternatives, the bundled hardware provides an integrated balance of dedicated GPU acceleration, local scratch storage, and host resources. This profile fits deep learning inference, legacy training tasks, scientific simulations, and parallel analytics.
